phrases.def: 德尔蒂专家收集明信片

sentences.en: Collecting must be one of the most varied of human activities, and it's one that many of us psychologists find fascinating.
sentences.zh: 收集一定是人类活动中最多样化的活动之一,也是我们许多心理学家都认为很有趣的活动之一。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Many forms of collecting have been dignified with a technical name: an archtophilist collects teddy bears, a philatelist collects postage stamps, and a deltiologist collects postcards.
sentences.zh: 许多形式的收藏都被赋予了一个专业的名称：收藏家收集泰迪熊,集邮家收集邮票,而德尔蒂学家收集明信片。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Amassing hundreds or even thousands of postcards, chocolate wrappers or whatever, takes time, energy and money that could surely be put to much more productive use.
sentences.zh: 收集数百甚至数千张明信片、巧克力包装纸或其他任何东西,需要时间、精力和金钱,而这些时间、精力和金钱肯定可以得到更有效的利用。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And yet there are millions of collectors around the world.
sentences.zh: 然而世界各地有数以百万计的收藏家。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Why do they do it?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么这么做？

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There are the people who collect because they want to make money - this could be called an instrumental reason for collecting; that is, collecting as a means to an end.
sentences.zh: 有些人收藏是因为他们想赚钱——这可以称为收藏的工具性原因；也就是说,收集作为达到目的的手段。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: They'll look for, say, antiques that they can buy cheaply and expect to be able to sell at a profit.
sentences.zh: 例如,他们会寻找可以便宜购买并期望能够获利的古董。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: But there may well be a psychological element, too-buying cheap and selling dear can give the collector a sense of triumph.
sentences.zh: 但很可能有一个心理因素,低价买高卖会给收藏家带来一种胜利感。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: And as selling online is so easy, more and more people are joining in.
sentences.zh: 由于网上销售如此简单,越来越多的人加入其中。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Many collectors collect to develop their social life, attending meetings of a group of collectors and exchanging information on items.
sentences.zh: 许多收藏家通过收藏来发展他们的社交生活,参加收藏家小组的会议并交换物品信息。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This is a variant on joining at bridge club or a gym, and similarly brings them into contact with like-minded people,
sentences.zh: 这是加入桥牌俱乐部或健身房的一种变体,同样可以让他们与志同道合的人接触,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Another motive for collecting is the desire to find something special, or a particular example of the collected item, such as a rare early recording by a particular singer.
sentences.zh: 收藏的另一个动机是希望找到一些特别的东西,或者所收藏物品的特定示例,例如特定歌手的罕见早期录音。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some may spend their whole lives in a hunt for this.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能一生都在寻找这个。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Psychologically, this can give a purpose to a life that otherwise feels aimless.
sentences.zh: 从心理上来说,这可以为原本漫无目的的生活赋予目标。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: There is a danger, though, that if the individual is ever lucky enough to find what they're looking for, rather than celebrating their success, they may feel empty, now that the goal that drove them on has gone.
sentences.zh: 然而,存在一个危险,即如果个人足够幸运地找到他们正在寻找的东西,他们可能会感到空虚,而不是庆祝他们的成功,因为驱动他们前进的目标已经消失了。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: If you think about collecting postage stamps, another potential reason for it-or, perhaps, a result of collecting-is its educational value.
sentences.zh: 如果您考虑收集邮票,另一个潜在的原因 - 或者也许是收集的结果 - 是它的教育价值。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Stamp collecting opens a window to other countries, and to the plants, animals, or famous people shown on their stamps.
sentences.zh: 集邮打开了一扇了解其他国家以及邮票上的植物、动物或名人的窗口。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Similarly, in the 19th century, many collectors amassed fossils, animals and plants from around the globe, and their collections provided a vast amount of information about the natural world.
sentences.zh: 同样,在19世纪,许多收藏家收集了来自世界各地的化石、动物和植物,他们的收藏提供了大量有关自然世界的信息。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Without those collections, our understanding would be greatly inferior to what it is.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这些集合,我们的理解将大大不如现在。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the pastand nowadays, too, though to a lesser extent - a popular form of collecting, particularly among boys and men, was trainspotting.
sentences.zh: 在过去和现在,猜火车也是一种流行的收藏形式,尤其是在男孩和男人中,尽管程度较小。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This might involve trying to see every locomotive of a particular type, using published data that identifies each one, and ticking off each engine as it is seen.
sentences.zh: 这可能涉及尝试查看特定类型的每个机车,使用识别每个机车的已发布数据,并在看到的每个引擎上打勾。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: Trainspotters exchange information, these days often by mobile phone, so they can work out where to go to, to see a particular engine.
sentences.zh: 火车观察员现在经常通过手机交换信息,这样他们就可以知道要去哪里,看看特定的火车头。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: As a by-product, many practitioners of hobby become very knowledgeable about railway operations, or the technical specifications of different engine types.
sentences.zh: 作为副产品,许多业余爱好从业者变得非常了解铁路运营或不同发动机类型的技术规格。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Similarly, people who collect dolls may go beyond simply enlarging their collection, and develop an interest in the way that dolls are made, or the materials that are used.
sentences.zh: 同样,收集娃娃的人可能不仅仅只是扩大他们的收藏,还对娃娃的制作方式或使用的材料产生兴趣。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: These have changed over the centuries from the wood that was standard in 16th century Europe, through the wax and porcelain of later centuries, to the plastics of today's dolls.
sentences.zh: 几个世纪以来,这些玩具已经发生了变化,从 16 世纪欧洲标准的木材,到后来几个世纪的蜡和瓷器,再到今天娃娃的塑料。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Or collectors might be inspired to study how dolls reflect notions of what children like, or ought to like.
sentences.zh: 或者收藏家可能会受到启发去研究玩偶如何反映孩子们喜欢或应该喜欢什么的概念。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Not all collectors are interested in learning from their hobby, though, so what we might call a psychological reason for collecting is the need for a sense of control, perhaps as a way of dealing with insecurity.
sentences.zh: 然而,并非所有收藏家都有兴趣从他们的爱好中学习,所以我们可以称之为收藏的心理原因是需要一种控制感,也许作为处理不安全感的一种方式。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Stamp collectors, for instance, arrange their stamps in albums, usually very neatly, organising their collection according to certain commonplace principles - perhaps by country in alphabetical order, or grouping stamps by what they depict - people, birds, maps, and so on.
sentences.zh: 例如,集邮者将他们的邮票排列在相册中,通常非常整齐,根据某些常见原则组织他们的收藏 - 可能按国家/地区按字母顺序排列,或者根据邮票所描绘的内容（人物、鸟类、地图等）对邮票进行分组。

grammar.type: 分词结构 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One reason, conscious or not, for what someone chooses to collect is to show the collector's individualism.
sentences.zh: 有人选择收藏的原因之一,无论是否有意,都是为了表现收藏家的个人主义。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Someone who decides to collect something as unexpected as dog collars, for instance, maybe conveying their belief that they must be interesting themselves.
sentences.zh: 某人决定收集像狗项圈这样意想不到的东西,例如,也许传达了他们的信念：他们自己一定很有趣。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: And believe it or not, there is at least one dog collar museum in existence, and it grew out of a personal collection.
sentences.zh: 不管你相信与否,至少存在一个狗项圈博物馆,它是由个人收藏发展而来的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Of course, all hobbies give pleasure, but the common factor in collecting is usually passion: pleasure is putting it far too mildly.
sentences.zh: 当然,所有爱好都会带来快乐,但收藏的共同因素通常是激情：快乐说得太温和了。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: More than most other hobbies, collecting can be totally engrossing, and can give a strong sense of personal fulfilment.
sentences.zh: 与大多数其他爱好相比,收集可以完全引人入胜,并且可以给人一种强烈的个人成就感。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: To non-collectors it may appear an eccentric, if harmless, way of spending time, but potentially, collecting has a lot going for it.
sentences.zh: 对于非收藏家来说,这可能看起来是一种奇怪的、无害的消磨时间的方式,但收藏可能有很多好处。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 分词结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

questions.title: Questions 14-26
instructions: Questions 14-21: Complete the sentences below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the passage for each answer.
Questions 22-26: Do the following statements agree with the information given in the reading passage?

items.prompt: The writer mentions collecting …as an example of collecting in order to make money.
Collectors may get a feeling of … from buying and selling items.
Collectors’ clubs provide opportunities to share …
Collectors’ clubs offer…with people who have similar interests.
Collecting sometimes involves a life-long … for a special item.
Searching for something particular may prevent people from feeling their life is completely …
Stamp collecting may be…because it provides facts about different countries.
…tends to be mostly a male hobby.
The number of people buying dolls has grown over the centuries.
Sixteenth century European dolls were normally made of wax and porcelain.
Arranging a stamp collection by the size of the stamps is less common than other methods.
Someone who collects unusual objects may want others to think he or she is also unusual.
Collecting gives a feeling that other hobbies are unlikely to inspire.
